articleBodyHtml:
Schedule Changes and Meme Review

The host mentioned that a schedule change caused them to miss a chat, emphasizing the importance of rest for a good time with Coco. They also encouraged viewers to participate in the meme review, highlighting it as a significant opportunity.

Attendees expressed appreciation for the interaction and acknowledged a shared interest in the meme review. The host also thanked the viewers for their support and referenced a previous comment from Vel the Vile.
